paras: The Mindanao sphenomorphus (Pinoyscincus mindanensis)  is a species of skink, a lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to the Philippines.
P. mindanensis is found in the southern Philippines, on the islands of Bohol, Leyte, and Mindanao.
The preferred natural habitat of P. mindanensis is forest, at altitudes of 500–1,500 m (1,600–4,900 ft).
Adults of P. mindanensis have a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of about 5 cm (2.0 in).
The mode of reproduction of P. mindanensis is unknown.
